name: matched-historical-etf-augmentation-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Earlier chronological market regimes may improve trading generalization beyond equal-mass recent-ETF oversampling. Compare both controls, retain failed outcomes, and stop at the fixed gate.
selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean validation net return; no declining-stock label selection

screen_gate.failure: Stop after seed11; no confirmation, longer run or parameter sweep. Preserve all checkpoints and reports.

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Repeated2021-2023 development evidence only. Frozen prospective confirmation still required; never claim success from one selected checkpoint.

constraints.normalization: Original immutable training-only normalizer and seven indicators identical in every arm; no refit on validation or older labels
constraints.episodes: Original episodes untouched; earlier ETFs get independent feature warmup and final20-row purge. Additional recent ETF episodes duplicate only existing training episodes.
constraints.sampling: Uniform training episode, then uniform start with entire window remaining. Recent/older augmented arms each have8/30 expected ETF episode mass and4/30 extra episode mass; original4/26. Record actual starts/transitions by symbol and earlier/recent history. No outcome labels.
constraints.execution: Identical100k equity, whole shares, exposure cap1,20-session holding limit, long/short four-component actions, next-session execution and default costs
constraints.validation: Same immutable original26-symbol2021-2023 panel and matched holding dates, selected/final weights reported
constraints.short_side: Report positive total returns AND positive net short P&L jointly for ex-post falling-stock cohorts; reporting only, never inputs/sampling/reward/checkpoint selection
constraints.limitations: Retrospective survivor stocks/ETFs and revised Yahoo units, not PIT membership/delisting coverage or independent market evidence
constraints.training_location: Google Colab only; actual default Python checked before dependency sync

execution.runner: Existing central metered owned fleet with shared original ledger
execution.preflight: One512-transition CPU Colab smoke per arm before50k screen; verify kernel/dependencies, fixed windows, group counters, frozen restoration and teardown
execution.cleanup: Retrieve durable models/reports/checkpoints; verify every owned runtime stopped; publish and verify assets before duplicate-only removal
execution.readiness: Prepared data and local sampler tests do not authorize skipping metered job/artifact validation; freeze one committed source before allocation.
